description: This shell script automates testing scenarios for cherry-picking and reverting merges in a Git repository. It includes setup procedures, various test cases for handling merge commits, and expectations for command outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a given description.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command returns a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.
